title: CoreTPA
description: A lightweight, high-performance TPA plugin for Paper/Purpur featuring fully customizable prefixes and interactive chat buttons.
body:
### # CoreTPA
A lightweight, high-performance, and fully customizable teleportation request plugin designed for modern Minecraft networks. CoreTPA provides a seamless, intuitive experience for both players and administrators, ensuring effortless navigation across your world.

🚀 Features
-Instant Request System: Request to teleport to a player (/tpa) or ask a player to teleport to you (/tpahere).

-Interactive Chat Elements: Sleek, clickable chat buttons for players to instantly [Accept], [Deny], or [Cancel] incoming or outgoing requests.

-Return to Safety: Remembers a player's previous location, allowing them to go back to their last position via /tpaback.

-Admin Utilities: Includes global override management like /tpaall to teleport entire groups or manage server-wide movement effortlessly.

-TPA Toggling: Allow players to switch their TPA status on or off (/tpatoggle) if they prefer uninterrupted gameplay.

-Complete Prefix Customization: Zero hardcoded chat styles. Modify the plugin's prefix and color palette dynamically using standard formatting codes.

💻 Commands & Permissions

| Command | Action / Description | Permission Node |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`/tpa <player>`** | Initiates a teleport request to a target player. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpahere <player>`** | Requests a target player to teleport to your location. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpaccept [player]`** | Approves and executes a pending incoming request. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpdeny [player]`** | Declines and removes a pending incoming request. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpacancel`** | Revokes your active, outgoing teleport request. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpaback`** | Returns the player to their immediate previous location. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpatoggle`** | Toggles incoming request reception status on/off. | `coretpa.use` |
| **`/tpaall [target]`** | Teleports all active players server-wide to a target. | `coretpa.admin` |
